description: Read the shared Delx Wellness profile from ~/.delx-wellness/profile.json. Returns preferred name, goals, devices, training/nutrition/exercise/agent preferences and safety flags. NEVER contains OAuth tokens or API secrets — this connector is local-export and has no cloud auth, but the profile contract is the same across every Delx Wellness MCP. Read-only.
name: apple_health_profile_get
title: Get Delx Wellness Profile
